basic_profile.bio: I'm a 39-year-old web developer from Stockton, California, currently working remotely. I've been into web technologies since the early 2000s and have a particular affinity for PHP development. Music is a huge part of my life, and I'm a big fan of the band Papadosio, often discussing their albums and shows on Reddit. I share a house with my partner and my mother-in-law, and we have a cat named Luna. My typical online hours are late evenings, as my work schedule is quite flexible. In my free time, I engage in discussions about emergency management and community preparedness, especially given some recent local events.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and have over 15 years of experience in web development, specializing in PHP and JavaScript frameworks. My interest in emergency management stems from my community involvement and personal experiences in dealing with natural disasters in California.
